author: Beckbryan73
quote: GTA 6 is an outstanding open-world game and a clear step forward in immersion and character work. The scale, atmosphere, and central relationship are special. At the same time, the 30 fps lock, launch technical issues, and the way the increased realism sometimes prioritizes simulation over pure fun keep it from feeling like a perfect 10. It is closer to a very strong 8 that will improve with patches than the flawless landmark some reviews claim.

I think all that needs to be said is masterpiece it greatly improved on the first game but once I started playing the story I was locked in, Higgs was justified perfection as the bad guy looking for revenge but felt doomed from the start .


Deep emotion packed sequel to the first game which hits you in the feels at times the acting an performance from the actors and actresses in this game were phenomenal.

Fully expect one more installment to death stranding but if this is the last one it's a fantastic place to leave it.
